Whether the Plaintiff is entitled to a decree for a sum  of Rs.51,60,641/-?

All modifications or amendments to  this LOI shall be in writing.
The parties hereto agree that time shall be of essence in performance  and fulfillment of each and every obligation of the parties hereto set  forth in this LOI.
In light of the above facts, circumstances and reasons KLA Foods India Ltd. Vs. Field Fresh Foods Pvt. Ltd. (Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd.) the issue no.1 is decided against the plaintiff.
I shall next decide issues no. 2, 3 and 5, which are reproduced below:
Whether the Plaintiff is entitled to costs of the suit?
Whether the suit filed by the Plaintiff lacks cause of action?
OPD In view of the issue no.1 being decided against the plaintiff, the issues no.2, 3 are decided against the plaintiff, whereas, the issue no.5 is decided in favour of the defendant.
In view of the above, the suit of the plaintiff is dismissed with no order as to costs.
